name: v0.2.6
body:
## 🎵 3nity Media v0.2.6

Modern cross-platform media player powered by libmpv.

### 📦 Downloads

#### Linux
| Format | File | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| **DEB** | `3nity-media_0.2.6_amd64.deb` | Ubuntu, Debian, Linux Mint |
| **AppImage** | `3nity-Media-0.2.6-x86_64.AppImage` | Universal, portable |
| **Snap** | `3nity-media_0.2.6_amd64.snap` | Snap Store compatible |
| **Portable** | `3nity-media-linux-portable-0.2.6.tar.gz` | tar.gz archive |

#### Windows
| Format | File | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| **Installer** | `3nity-Media-Setup-0.2.6.exe` | System install (Admin) |
| **User Installer** | `3nity-Media-Setup-User-0.2.6.exe` | No admin required |
| **Portable** | `3nity-media-windows-portable-0.2.6.zip` | ZIP archive |

---

### 🛠️ Installation

#### Linux - DEB (Ubuntu/Debian)
```bash
wget https://github.com/NDXDeveloper/3nity-media/releases/download/v0.2.6/3nity-media_0.2.6_amd64.deb
sudo apt install ./3nity-media_0.2.6_amd64.deb
```

#### Linux - AppImage
```bash
wget https://github.com/NDXDeveloper/3nity-media/releases/download/v0.2.6/3nity-Media-0.2.6-x86_64.AppImage
chmod +x 3nity-Media-0.2.6-x86_64.AppImage
./3nity-Media-0.2.6-x86_64.AppImage
```

#### Linux - Snap Store (Recommended)
```bash
sudo snap install 3nity-media
```
Or visit: https://snapcraft.io/3nity-media

#### Linux - Snap (Manual)
```bash
wget https://github.com/NDXDeveloper/3nity-media/releases/download/v0.2.6/3nity-media_0.2.6_amd64.snap
sudo snap install --dangerous 3nity-media_0.2.6_amd64.snap
```

#### Windows
- **System installer:** Download and run `3nity-Media-Setup-0.2.6.exe`
- **User installer:** Download and run `3nity-Media-Setup-User-0.2.6.exe` (no admin required)
- **Portable:** Extract `3nity-media-windows-portable-0.2.6.zip`

---

### ✨ Features

- 🎬 Audio/video playback with libmpv
- 📋 Playlist management (M3U, PLS, XSPF)
- 📻 Internet radio / streaming
- 🎛️ Audio equalizer
- 🎨 Visual effects
- ⌨️ Customizable keyboard shortcuts
- 🌍 Multi-language support

### 📋 Linux Dependencies

#### DEB (Ubuntu/Debian)
- `libqt5pas1` - Qt5 Pascal bindings
- `libmpv2` or `libmpv1` - Playback engine
- `ffmpeg` - Metadata extraction (ffprobe)

> **Note:** AppImage and Snap bundle their dependencies (including ffprobe).
> For Fedora/openSUSE users, please use the AppImage or Snap version.

### 📖 Full Installation Guide
See `INSTALL` for detailed installation instructions including how to install prerequisites (sudo, snapd) on all Linux distributions.

### ✅ Verification
SHA256 checksums are available in `checksums.txt`.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NDXDeveloper/3nity-media/compare/v0.2.5...v0.2.6
